Benefits with Veterans is an independent insurance agency, not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, the U.S. government, or the military. Private insurance is separate from VA benefits. Insurance products are subject to insurer terms, exclusions, underwriting and state availability. No coverage, benefit amount or premium is guaranteed by this website.

Your privacy: Our coverage questionnaire asks for your coverage interest, age range, state, optional planning budget, name, phone, email, preferred contact method and consent choices. It does not request a Social Security number, exact birth date, health information or banking details. Before submission, answers remain in this page’s memory only and are cleared by reloading or leaving the page; no browser storage is used. When intake is enabled, submitted requests are stored on the server and made available only to authorized agency personnel for follow-up. Required consent covers responding to your request; automated marketing consent is separate, optional and unchecked. You can ask to withdraw consent or request access or deletion at info@benefitswithveterans.com, subject to legal recordkeeping requirements. Retention periods and the final privacy notice require launch review; intake remains unavailable until the service is configured. Preview testing must use fictional information only. Our hosting provider may process standard server logs. There are no advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Rate-check links take you to Ethos; individual booking links take you to Google Calendar. Those services have their own privacy policies and terms. Please do not send sensitive health, identity or financial details by email.
